name: Frame studio
description: Make a Magic Set Editor frame from a proxy maker's frame template (one picture per colour, or a Photoshop file – each colour put together from its layers, the text placed from its text layers, its own mana symbols), or design one from scratch with the Frame designer (lots of settings, a live preview, and AI that designs from a description or paints textures). Fonts that come with it are installed for MSE; your cards can use it like any other frame.
author: MEZTKING

page.title: Frame studio
page.tooltip: Make an MSE frame from a proxy maker's blank frames or your own pictures
